name: Aelnir Construction Calculator
seoTitle: Aelnir Construction Calculator: offline material and cost estimates
summary: Quantities, materials and costs for concrete, brick, tile, paint, rebar and more. Works offline.
tagline: Quantities, materials and costs for concrete, brick, tile, paint, rebar and more. Works offline, with your own local material rates.

features.title: From measurements to a costed project
features.lead: No account, no backend, no sensitive permissions.

items.title: Sixteen calculators
items.body: Concrete, brick, block, plaster, tile, paint, flooring, rebar, excavation, backfill, roofing, area, volume, water tanks, pipes and land area.

items.title: Shows its working
items.body: Every result comes with its formula, the assumptions behind it and any warnings, so you can check the numbers before you buy.

items.title: Your local rates
items.body: Start from material presets, add your own materials and prices, and include labour and markups in the cost.

items.title: Whole projects
items.body: Group calculations into a project, see the totals, recost when prices change, and duplicate or undo as you go.

items.title: Any unit
items.body: Metric and imperial, mixed units and feet-and-inches, plus a unit converter for everything else.

items.title: Export and keep
items.body: Share a project as CSV or plain text. History and favourites stay on your phone.

strip.label: Calculates
strip.text: Concrete · Brick · Block · Plaster · Tile · Paint · Flooring · Rebar · Excavation · Backfill · Roofing · Area · Volume · Water tank · Pipes · Land area · Unit converter

note.label: Free, with ads
note.title: Works on site, without signal
note.body: Aelnir Construction Calculator is free and supported by ads. Every calculator works offline, and your projects, rates and history stay on your phone.

studioProof.hard: A unit, formula and costing engine covered by about 234 automated tests.
